name: Ryan's operation, September 30, 2026
description: Drawn from the owner's brief of 2026-09-30 and kept generic where a detail is not needed. The repositories are the only links between accounts and machines, plus Ryan carrying prompts. Assumed, to be corrected by the owner: that the research lanes run on the same cloud account as the Operator and hand work to each other through their own repository; that Codex is given its prompts by hand and returns work through a repository branch; how many test runners and routines there are.

sessions.name: Operator
sessions.role: Keeps the plan; starts and steers the worker sessions, test runners and routines

sessions.name: Worker lanes
sessions.role: Each builds one piece of Splashery on its own branch

sessions.name: Test runners
sessions.role: Run the test suites against a branch and report what failed

sessions.name: Scheduled routines
sessions.role: Wake on a schedule to check on the work and nudge the Operator

sessions.name: Research lanes
sessions.role: A private research project, worked in its own cloud sessions

sessions.name: grooph session
sessions.role: Builds grooph: exports, operation maps and the live view the Operator will use

sessions.name: Codex
sessions.model: GPT-6.1 Sol and other OpenAI models
